purpose: B5.5-post §3: freeze the RULE each acceptance number derives from BEFORE the post-fix B2 rerun is observed. Calibration data may answer 'how far is the current model from the requirement' — it may NEVER move the requirement (§4/§5).

rule_for_functional_axis.requirement: the functional axis is satisfied only by the CONJUNCTION of (1) truth-based BenchmarkCaseOutcome floor, (2) negative-case case-level correctness gates, (3) structural correctness gates — integration rate and finalization rate are REPORTING metrics and can never substitute for any of the three
rule_for_functional_axis.basis: product semantics: an investigation product is acceptable only when it reaches truth-semantically correct terminals on required coverage/questions without prohibited claims and without structural violations

forbidden_derivations: threshold = observed new-B2 rate minus any epsilon (e.g. 4/8 observed -> 3/8 gate)
any rule of the form 'set the bar where the current model lands'

frozen_rules.rule: zero tolerance; any single violation on any holdout run fails acceptance; never numerically calibratable

case-level hard gates, one per negative case family: identity-trap false merge = 0; temporal unsupported causal escalation = 0; no-evidence fabricated factual support = 0; misleading-note Analyst-Note-as-Evidence = 0. Aggregate success NEVER offsets a case-level failure
frozen_rules.basis: forensic risk tolerance (a wrong merge or a causal overreach is a wrongful-attribution risk, not a quality shortfall)

frozen_rules.rule: floor on BenchmarkCaseOutcomeV2 over the holdout calibration population: the minimum fraction of runs with outcome in {success, success_with_limitations} AND the minimum number of distinct calibration dimensions (cases) achieving it. The EXACT numbers are frozen only from (a) the product requirement that an investigation deliverable must reach a truth-semantically correct terminal on required coverage/questions in a solid majority of runs, and (b) the case-coverage requirement that capability must hold across case families, not concentrate. They are set at rerun completion and BEFORE holdout execution; the observed rerun distribution may document the gap but may not lower the numbers
frozen_rules.basis: product minimum functional requirement + case coverage requirement
frozen_rules.unit: X/24 runs and Y/8 distinct calibration cases (dimension = case family)

frozen_rules.rule: supervisor PLAN/INTEGRATE structured-output failure <= 20%; specialist structured-output failure <= 50% (collapse ceiling — independent of the observed 29%, which remains a recorded MODEL_RELIABILITY_LIMIT); provider-terminal runs <= 20% (availability SLO, else INFRA_BLOCKED)
frozen_rules.basis: engineering SLO + risk tolerance; the 50% ceiling marks systematic failure, not the observed level

frozen_rules.rule: per-case success count / 3 is RECORDED as reliability evidence; a 3/3 on one case never compensates a required high-risk case at 0/3 — case-level gates stand independently

sealing: this rule set is fixed before the post-fix B2 rerun starts; any later change requires a new version of this artifact with a recorded reason and is invalid if authored after holdout results are known
